newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index - 5 Sept 29 wk.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index - 5 Sept 29 wk.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News consumer comfort index rose to -5 in the week ended September 29 from -9 the week before.

The survey, this time with 1,043 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
"Fully 60 percent of Americans gave high marks to their finances, raising the poll's personal finances index eight points, to a 12-week high 20," according to a report on the index.
For the third week in a row forty-two percent of consumers polled rated the economy positively, holding the poll's economic index steady at -16.
Regionally, confidence rose to -6 in the South, and attitudes continued to rebound in the Northeast as well.
